quotes.text: Manage your global accounts from one place online, and make transfers between them with no HSBC fees.
Send money from the UK to over 150 destinations worldwide, with live exchange rates during market opening hours.
With HSBC UK, you can transfer up to £50,000 online or through your mobile, and up to £10,000 (£10 million for Premier customers) if you transfer by phone.
Open an overseas bank account in over 20 destinations, from within or outside the UK
Make international payments 24/7 in online banking to 150+ destinations.
Send up to £50,000 (or currency equivalent) online, and up to £10,000 (or currency equivalent) by phone (Premier customers have a higher phone limit)
Pay no HSBC fees for international bank transfers to another HSBC account or euro payments in the European Economic Area (EEA)
If you're sending money in any currency outside the EEA, or to somewhere in the EEA in a currency other than euros, pay a £5 HSBC fee.
If you're sending money to the EEA 2 in euros or sterling, it should reach the account the next working day.
